system.description:
Shinbi looked across the battlefield where multiple bodies lay either lifeless or almost there. Fireballs and Walls of Stone pepper the battlefield as the attacks have not stopped. She closed her eyes for a moment to envision the world in her mind’s eye. She saw the enemies begin to move towards the left flank to be stopped by her men trying to stave them off. This leads to more troops bursting through the defense set up in the center of the battlefield, her men would be powerless to stop it, she would be assaulted and the battle would be lost. She opens her eyes and begins to speak “The enemy knows we are wounded and weak, allow them to think that. They will be coming soon, it’s a trap we will set for them, let them come, Set explosive Traps along the way. We are making a tactical retreat.” Her men look confused but listen nonetheless. As they make their way out, the left flank is breached as they rush towards the retreating party, Shinbi makes a single hand seal as the explosives go off stopping them in their tracks and crippling their assault.

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 10 excerpt.

Inconceivable foresight

The Nara Clan or Nara Family is one of the many clans of Konohagakure. They are known for tending deer and their ability to manipulate shadows through the use of Yin Release.

There are stories of men and women who can see battles before they happen, see victories and defeats before the first weapons are drawn and can route those victories or prevent those defeats all within the span of a moment. These men and women came together and over the years consolidated their knowledge and insight and became known as the Nara Clan. The Nara clan has a special relationship with the Akimichi and the Yamanaka clan. For several generations, members of these three families have formed "Ino–Shika–Cho" trios.

Nara Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Wis

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Investigation, Insight

Nara Hijutsu: The Nara Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Nara Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

Nara Features

Shadow Arts

1st Level Clan Feature

The Nara clan teaches you to think in silhouettes and the curvature of light. How to isolate a foe and get information out of them. How to use your shadow to strangle an army. But this takes focus, coordination and requires you to enter the Shadow Art stance.

You can enter your Shadow Art stance as a Bonus Action. This is treated as a Chakra stance for you. While in this stance you gain the following benefits:

Shadow Possession. As an Action, you can select a creature you can see within 40 feet of you, as your shadow snakes across the ground, connecting with their shadow. The affected creature must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your highest Jutsu save. On a failure, the target becomes Shadow Bound. A Shadow bound creature makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC at the end of each of their turns, ending this condition on a success.

Shadows Reach. The range of Shadow Possession increases by +20 feet at 7th level and 15th level.

Limited Shadow. You can only hold 1 creature at a time using Shadow Possession. This increases to 2 at 7th and 3 at 15th. You can select additional creatures when you spend your action to Shadow Possession as you gain the ability to hold more creatures, up to the number of creatures you can hold.

Distorted Shadow. You cannot use Shadow Possession if you cannot mold chakra, or maintain concentration on jutsu.

Time of Day. Your jutsu gain their associated time of day effect based on what your GM says most matches your environmental scenario; Bright or Dimly Lit

| Shadow Possession – Shadow Bound / [Physical] / A Shadow Bound creature is Restrained and Grappled in place. / This condition ends early if any of the following occurs: / A Shadow Bound creature is moved as a result of another creature or effect moving them. / The creature that bound you is incapacitated or cannot mold chakra. / The creature that bound you cannot see you. / You or the creature that bound you is covered by total darkness. / When you would make or remake your saving throw to end this effect, you do not roll at disadvantage. |

Operational Contingencies

| #### Combat Coordinated / Will Amp / You move as a team, with your team. / Coordinated Start. As part of rolling initiative, you gain a rank of Mastery to your initiative. This becomes 2 ranks at 7th and 3 ranks at 15th level. / Team Coordination. You can select a willing allies creature to go in your place in initiative. This counts as their turn for initiative. If you take another Combat Coordinated creatures place in initiative, you must give your place in initiative to another Combat Coordinated creature. / Coordinated Support. If another Combat Coordinated creature is under the effect of a condition or hostile effect that requires an ability or skill check, or a saving throw, you can spend your reaction to make that check or saving throw for them using your statistics. |

3rd Level Clan Feature

You don’t react. You knew what was going to happen hours ago, and you planned a contingency for it immediately afterwards.

At the beginning of each of your turns, you can spend your Bonus Action to establish a Contingency. A Contingency is combination of a Cause (Trigger) and an Effect (Result). This increases to two Contingencies as part of the same bonus action at 11th level.

When you do, select one Cause(trigger) and then one Effect(result), which form a single Contingency. A Contingency is prepared until the beginning of your next turn. If a Cause occurs within this duration, then the Effect is applied at the same time as the Cause occurring.

Cause

An allied creature is targeted by an attack.

| #### Diplomatic Coordination / Social Amp / You move as a team, with your team. / Coordinated Words. You gain a rank of Mastery to either Deception, Persuasion or Intimidation (pick one) for the remainder of this social encounter. This becomes 2 ranks at 7th and 3 ranks at 15th level. / Coordinated Experience. If your Background is related to or associated with the opposing creature, you gain advantage on Insight checks. |

An allied creature fails a saving throws.

An allied creature gains a Physical Condition.

An allied creature gains a Mental Condition.

A hostile creature you can see casts a jutsu with a Hand Sign (HS) component.

A hostile creature that you can see, begins their turn concentrating on a jutsu.

A hostile creature you can see moves within 10 feet of an allied creature.

Effect

Grant an allied creature a rank of mastery to their AC, until the beginning of their next turn.

Grant an allied creature a rank of mastery to their saving throws, until the beginning of their next turn.

An allied creature can remake their saving throw for any effect currently applied to them.

An allied creature makes an opportunity attack against a hostile creature they can see within their range at no reaction cost.

An allied creature spends their reaction to move up to 10 feet without triggering attacks of opportunities. If this movement takes them out of range of an area effect, they are no longer a target and if they move out of range of a hostile creatures attack, the hostile creature must choose a new valid target.

An allied creature spends their reaction to cast a jutsu with a casting time of 1 Action against a hostile creature in its range.

Team Coordination

7th Level Clan Feature

Your team has come to depend on you and your clans strategic minds. You’ve brought it with you and plan on making sure your team has a tactical advantage in every scenario. When you roll initiative or begin a social encounter your allies begin coordinating around you.

All allies gain the Coordinated condition until initiative ends. There are two different variants of Coordinated, one focused on combat called Combat Coordination, the other for Social encounters called Diplomatic Coordination.

Shogi Board

11th Level Clan Feature

Every battlefield is a shogi board that only you can see. Every ally and adversary, a piece on the board. Every moment, a gesture to checkmate.

When you use Shadow Possession or cast a Nara Hijutsu that inflicts the Shadow Bound condition, while you have Contingencies established, you can dismiss one Contingency to command two of your allied to spend their reaction to Cast a jutsu with a casting time of 1 Action or use a clan feature they know, that costs an Action. When they do, they must target the same creature you do.

As part of this feature, you and your chosen allies determine the order of which effects are applied. (If the chosen allies cast the Human Boulder Hijutsu or uses the Mind Body Transfer clan feature or Mind Body Disturbance Hijutsu then they make their attacks with a rank of mastery and force the target creature to make their saving throw with a -2 penalty to their saving throw)

Mendokusē

15th Level Clan Feature

At this point in your career. You’ve seen it all. Your enemies strategies aren’t new or inventive. You haven’t struggled to find a solution in a long time and it’s become boring. What a drag, right?

You can set up 1 Contingency at the start of your turn, without spending a bonus action. If you do, you cannot spend a Bonus action to establish a Contingency.

You can use Shadow Possession as a Bonus action instead of an Action. If you do, you cannot use Shadow Possession as an Action.
